title: Hal Saflieni Hypogeum Oracle Room tuned to 111 Hz
summary: Jay Anderson tells of Hal Saflieni Hypogeum Oracle Room tuned to 111 Hz, about Neolithic at Hypogeum, Malta, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And this place is precision tuned to 111 hertz.

plain: Jay Anderson, a man who says he visited the Hal Saflieni Hypogeum, a very old underground chamber complex in Malta, says that a space in it called the Oracle Room is precisely tuned to sound at 111 hertz, a particular low pitch. He tells it because, if true, the ancient builders shaped the room for sound on purpose, with knowledge we would not expect them to have.
